entry.why: Changing a habit's period would break the meaning of its history: existing habit_targets rows, check-ins and progress are bucketed by week/month/year, and target_count limits depend on the period. Rejecting it outright keeps those records consistent, and refusing explicitly (rather than silently ignoring the field) tells the client the change isn't supported.
entry.tradeoff: Users who want a different period must create a new habit, losing continuity with the old one's history, in exchange for avoiding re-bucketing and recomputing past progress.
